WITH per_driver AS (
  SELECT
    driverId,
    AVG(points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE points > 1.0
  GROUP BY driverId
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins
  FROM per_driver
)
SELECT
  p.driverId,
  p.avg_points,
  p.avg_wins,
  p.avg_wins - m.mean_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_driver AS p
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
